About

A six-piece jazz ensemble from Leeds combining electronic and acoustic instruments. High-energy sets move from intricate compositions to immersive soundscapes, drawing on The Prodigy, John Coltrane and Nubiyan Twist.

Highlights

  • Six-piece electronic and acoustic line-up
  • Recent and upcoming European touring
